challenge_contract.extension_rule: extend its retained atomic consumption with exact package bytes/digest before publication; preserve its acceptance-only receipt API and historical contract bytes

closure_rationale.enrollment_reference: parent names the field but does not freeze its canonical wire encoding
closure_rationale.authorization_generation: parent names the field but does not define initial value or successor semantics
closure_rationale.authorization_version: parent names the field but does not define its version value
closure_rationale.lineage_generation: parent names the field but does not define initial lineage or recovery
closure_rationale.predecessor_package_digest_or_null: parent names the nullable field but does not define initial predecessor
closure_rationale.expiration: parent requires canonical UTC and rejection at or after expiry; it does not select a package duration or authenticated deadline policy
closure_rationale.quorum_envelope: parent freezes 2-of-3 Ed25519 authority but does not select two versus three supplied signatures, signature ordering or exact envelope fields

wire_contract.canonicalization: RFC8785 JCS UTF-8; no BOM, whitespace, newline, duplicate keys, floats or unknown fields; ASCII wire keys and positive interoperable exact integers

identity_issuance.provisioning_subject_id_profile: psub_<RFC9562 UUIDv7>; canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID, version 7, RFC variant 10
identity_issuance.enrollment_reference_profile: penr_<RFC9562 UUIDv7>; canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID, version 7, RFC variant 10
identity_issuance.uuid_timestamp: unsigned 48-bit floor(internal Unix epoch milliseconds) from one captured sub-second-precision UTC reservation instant shared by both identities; do not derive milliseconds from issued_at_utc whole seconds; timestamp is neither authority, uniqueness proof nor winner selection
identity_issuance.uuid_randomness: independent CSPRNG 12-bit rand_a and 62-bit rand_b for each identity; never derive either identity from caller, hardware, user, account, request nonce or the other identity
identity_issuance.durability: reserve both identities, exact canonical request bytes/digest and exact canonical payload in the same issuer-owned transaction before signing; unique indexes are the final conflict fence
identity_issuance.retry_and_restart: reuse the exact durable reservation; never remint after lost signing or publication response

initial_authorization.generation_role: first authorization in one retained subject/enrollment lineage; not a global issuance sequence
initial_authorization.version_role: version of this initial authorization protocol
initial_authorization.replacement_and_recovery: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; require a separate explicit subordinate freeze before admitting a successor

validity_policy.timestamps: real calendar UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; no offset, fractions or leap seconds
validity_policy.issued_at_utc: the same captured internal reservation UTC instant used for both UUIDv7 timestamps, truncated to whole UTC seconds for canonical wire encoding; no caller clock or timestamp override
validity_policy.expires_at_utc: minimum(exact signed retained PDSAEnrollmentChallengeV1.expires_at_utc, exact retained verified TPMEnrollmentChallengeV1.expires_at_utc)
validity_policy.endorsement_bound: ProductionTPMChallengeStore already limits its TPM challenge to the earlier signed PDSA challenge and curated signed TPM endorsement deadline; use only the verifier-issued exchange's retained raw challenge
validity_policy.window: issued_at_utc <= current UTC < expires_at_utc; require issued_at_utc < expires_at_utc
validity_policy.final_commit_gate: after acquiring the write lock recheck current Production Trust, live TPM exchange, request-key proof of possession and every source deadline; never publish an expired or no-longer-authenticated reservation
validity_policy.expired_reservation: fail closed; preserve its identities and history; do not renew timestamps, resurrect challenges or remint subject on retry
validity_policy.retained_retry: return already committed exact package bytes without refreshing validity; LPPI verification independently rejects expired packages

signature_profile.signature_encoding: exactly 64 Ed25519 bytes encoded as 128 lowercase hex characters
signature_profile.signature_order: exactly two distinct trusted key_id entries in lexical order; every supplied signature must verify
signature_profile.key_identity: resolve exclusively through genuine current ProductionTrustContext.pdsa_keys; no caller-selected public key set
signature_profile.signing_boundary: fixed trusted issuer-deployment internal quorum service; public issuance accepts no signer callback, private key, endpoint, service path or public keys
signature_profile.eligible_signer_set: exactly all three authorized key IDs and public keys from the current ProductionTrustContext.pdsa_keys, immutable with the exact Production Trust identity at reservation
signature_profile.signer_selection: any two distinct eligible keys chosen only by the trusted signing authority; lexical order determines envelope ordering, never the required pair
signature_profile.signing_service_request: authorized_signer_ids = exact reserved three-key set; required_threshold = 2; caller cannot select signers, threshold, public keys, endpoint or callback
signature_profile.service_idempotency_key: lowercase hex SHA256(exact reserved JCS UTF-8 canonical payload bytes)
signature_profile.service_retry: persist the exact first durable response for the reservation/payload digest, including selected signer IDs and exact signature bytes, before returning it; lost response, issuer crash or service restart must return that same response without reselecting the pair; conflicting response fails closed
signature_profile.service_authority: a signing-service response establishes no package authority until local exact-message verification of exactly two distinct lexically ordered eligible signers, both signatures and exact reserved/current Production Trust identity and key set followed by atomic terminal commit

target_binding.source: genuine require_authenticated_pre_enrollment(AuthenticatedProductionPreEnrollment) for the same ProductionEnrollmentIssuerContext, PDSAChallengeStore and ProductionTrustContext

payload_source_mapping.pdsa_challenge_id: authenticated request.pdsa_challenge_id exact-bound to retained signed challenge
payload_source_mapping.pdsa_challenge_digest_sha256: authenticated request.pdsa_challenge_digest_sha256 exact-bound to retained signed challenge envelope
payload_source_mapping.pre_enrollment_request_digest_sha256: SHA256(exact authenticated retained PreEnrollmentRequestV1 canonical bytes)
payload_source_mapping.pre_enrollment_public_key_fingerprint_sh: authenticated request fingerprint after canonical SEC1 recomputation and request PoP
payload_source_mapping.release_policy_digest_sha256: authenticated request.release_policy_digest_sha256 exact-bound to current Production Trust
payload_source_mapping.release_policy_generation: authenticated request.release_policy_generation exact-bound to current Production Trust

retention.owner: same trusted off-host ProductionEnrollmentIssuerContext deployment and domain as the PDSA challenge store
retention.issuer_provenance: installed fixed protected service principal/files; caller-selected path, copied database, reconstructed database or copied capability cannot register production issuer authority
retention.reserved: durably record immutable exact accepted request/challenge identity, source deadlines, both CSPRNG identities, generations, timestamps, canonical payload, exact Production Trust identity/public key set, all three authorized signer IDs and threshold 2; no selected pair is required before trusted signing-service selection; no public enrollment authority
retention.signing: quorum signing and reconciliation run outside SQLite write transactions; durable payload digest identifies the same signing-service operation across restart
retention.signed: verify and retain exact canonical envelope bytes, SHA256 digest and exact selected signer IDs for the reserved payload and authorized key set; SIGNED/COMMITTED retry requires the same selected pair and signature bytes; no publication or final challenge consumption
retention.committed: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; recheck provenance and live authentication; atomically retain accepted request, acceptance receipt, exact package bytes/digest, subject/reference and transition challenge ISSUED to CONSUMED plus issuance SIGNED to COMMITTED before response
retention.retained_field_resolution: minimum_retained_fields names semantic retained data; physical columns may use internal names, exact immutable joins to the same issuer-owned retained challenge row, and validated fields from exact retained canonical payload bytes; no caller references or mutable projections
retention.package_digest: lowercase hex SHA256(exact canonical signed envelope bytes including signatures)
retention.legacy_acceptance_only_consumed: no automatic package backfill or subject minting; fail closed because the retained acceptance receipt alone cannot reestablish live issuance authority
retention.legacy_fixed_pair_storage: fail closed when populated legacy issuance storage lacks the exact reserved Production Trust identity and three-key public set; preserve records and files; never reconstruct or rebind retained authority to current trust automatically
retention.crash_recovery: reuse durable identities, payload, exact Production Trust identity/key set, all three authorized signer IDs and threshold; reconcile the signing service by reserved payload digest to recover the exact first durable selected pair and signature bytes even before local SIGNED retention; only COMMITTED rows may return a package
retention.storage_guarantee: SQLite WAL/synchronous FULL plus trusted issuer custody provide crash/concurrency consistency; this does not claim arbitrary issuer-disk rollback protection
